source: 外研社选择性必修第三册 Unit 4 同主题完形(AI 助手的早晨/自动驾驶如何决策/软件写新闻/未来的 AI 医生/机器狗 Robutt/学会与 AI 共处)。选项同词性,答案唯一无双解,与阅读·听力关不复用文章。

passages.title: Morning with My AI Helper

If the weather looks bad, it (3)____ me to take an umbrella. On my way to school, the assistant (4)____ the fastest route and tells me which bus to catch. It has slowly learned my daily (5)____, so its advice fits me better and better. When I am not sure how to spell a word, I simply (6)____ it out loud and the answer appears at once. Some people (7)____ that we depend on such tools too much. Perhaps they are right. Still, I find that this kind of (8)____ saves me a lot of time and (9)____ my busy mornings far less stressful. I can hardly (10)____ how I once managed without it.

passages.title: How a Self-Driving Car Decides
passages.text: A self-driving car is full of cameras and sensors that watch the road all the (1)____. passages.title: When Software Writes the News
passages.text: Not long ago, every news report was written by a human (1)____. Today, that is starting to change. A computer program can take raw numbers and turn them into a clear, readable (3)____ in just a few seconds. This saves newspapers a great deal of (4)____ and money. However, many journalists are (5)____ about the future of their jobs. They fear that machines may soon (6)____ them in many simple tasks. Supporters of the technology (7)____ that it only does the boring work, leaving humans free to write deeper stories. Whether this is (8)____ remains to be seen. What is certain is that writers will need to keep learning new (9)____ if they want to stay useful. The way we (10)____ the news may never be quite the same again.

passages.title: Doctors of the Future
passages.text: Imagine visiting a hospital where part of your treatment is planned by artificial (1)____. This may sound strange, but it could happen sooner than we (2)____. Already, smart programs can study thousands of medical pictures and (3)____ signs of illness that a busy doctor might miss. In the future, AI may even help scientists find new (4)____ for serious diseases such as cancer. Tiny robots, smaller than a single (5)____, might one day travel through the body and clear away harmful ones. Of course, few patients would feel (6)____ seeing a robot instead of a human doctor right now. Trust takes (7)____ to build. Most experts agree that AI will not (8)____ doctors; instead, it will work beside them as a helpful (9)____. With such support, doctors may be able to treat more people and (10)____ more lives than ever before.

passages.title: A Boy and His Robot Dog
passages.text: On the Moon, a boy named Jimmy had a robot dog (1)____ Robutt. Robutt could not breathe or eat, yet it (2)____ Jimmy everywhere he went. To him, Robutt understood him and loved him, and that was what (8)____ most. He held the robot (9)____ in his arms and frowned. In the boy's heart, the difference between a machine and a living thing did not seem to (10)____ at all.

passages.title: Learning to Live with AI
passages.text: Artificial intelligence is no longer something from science fiction; it is already (1)____ of our daily lives. Like any powerful tool, it can be used for good or for (2)____. It also means remembering that a person, not a machine, is always (8)____ for how a tool is used. Saying "My AI did it" can never be an (9)____ for illegal or unfair behaviour.
